title: Survey 3D and game-engine MCP servers: what to think about as 3D work grows
why: shiv, Nov 1 12:24 CST, in chat to triage (page item 126): "spawn another opus session that looks at 3d and engine mcps (unity/blender/adobe/everything) to determine as we start doing more 3d what i may need to start thinking about". Owner named Opus for this lane (agent-model-cap grant for this spawn).
note: Research only; installs nothing. 1) Find MCP servers and Claude skills for 3D and engines: Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, Adobe (Substance, Photoshop, Illustrator, Firefly), three.js and WebGL tooling, glTF and asset pipelines, and any other well-used ones. 2) For each: what it lets Claude do, who maintains it and how active it is, what it needs (a desktop app, a licence, a GPU, an API key), and whether it can run in a cloud session or only on Shivam's computer. A read-only vet note for each (decision on outside code: vet before any install). 3) Name what Shivam may need to start thinking about as 3D work grows, each judged by the outcome it serves: licences and cost, hardware, where assets live and how big they get in git, build and test of 3D scenes (how a reviewer checks a scene), performance budgets, and how this fits our design rules (step web-design-guidelines covers browser 3D design; do not repeat it). Keep owner ruling Nov 1 12:23 CST: no optional regulation or standard load on builders. Output: a ranked list in the lane's report, plus page questions to triage for any pick Shivam must make. Done check: the report holds the list with a source link per tool, and every pick is on the page. Needs no answer. Lane: session_013NEJL1nELFhJD5Rm3xiUS3 (started Nov 1 12:25 CST). Landed on main in batch 56, #965 (merge 4b8037d4, Nov 1 16:11 CST). The survey is docs/plans/3d-tools-survey.md; page items 130 to 132 hold its picks.
